name: kxelectionemergency
title: Will Trump declare an election emergency before Nov 4, 2026?
settlement: Resolves Yes if Trump personally signs a qualifying executive action (executive order, memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding) declaring a national emergency regarding the 2026 midterm election before Nov 4, 2026, with the topic addressed in the operative text, title, or official White House summary. Ceremonial, incidental, verbal, cabinet-level, or legislative actions do not qualify.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability (in percentage points) that this market resolves Yes, i.e., that Trump formally signs a qualifying national-emergency action tied to the 2026 midterms before the deadline. Judge how much a given news item shifts that probability.
